Approximate east road20.05875m givesbase7.658751514798725m against endpoint model12.4m; west road20.36192m differs0.30m. River preview7.7589m is a coarse mapped-sample surface. Published+11mPWD source zero is not treated as an absolute PMTiles altitude. Exact flood stage, per-pier ground and current former-rail strip conversion remain unverified; retain the authored bare strip.
